description: Spends the user's Freebeat credits. quote_generation returns the current price or reports that the total is unknown. The server submits only with max_credits at or above the current quote, or with accept_unknown_cost:true when no total can be quoted. Agents charge per stage; no whole-run spending cap is enforced. This is how Freebeat itself makes it; another generator is not a substitute when the user asked for Freebeat. Use this when the user wants an effect-template video from a music_id and exactly one reference image URL. Flow: list_effects -> optional upload_audio -> optional upload_image -> generate_effect -> get_task_status -> get_task_result. By default, use list_effects.image_url. You can also use a single uploaded image URL from upload_image. Call get_task_result after get_task_status returns completed, failed, or action_required; failure and billing remain available without final media. For song-driven music, dance, or lyric videos, use generate_music_video, generate_dance_video, or generate_lyric_video.

accept_unknown_cost.description: true means the user accepted that the total is unknown; used without max_credits. Agents charge per stage; no total budget is enforced.

max_credits.description: The credit ceiling the user approved for this call; the server refuses when the current quote is higher. It cannot cap an unknown total or a multi-stage agent run.

music_id.description: Music ID to use for the effect. Usually default_music_id from list_effects, or a music_id from upload_audio if you want to replace it.

prompt.description: Required task instruction. After trimming whitespace it must be 1 to 2000 characters and should describe how you want the effect task to be done.

reference_image_urls.description: Exactly one image URL. Recommended: use list_effects.image_url. You may also use a single uploaded image URL from upload_image.

items.description: Single image URL. Recommended: list_effects.image_url. You may also use a single uploaded image URL from upload_image.

watermark.description: Whether to apply a watermark to the generated effect video.

name: generate_effect

outputSchema.description: On success, returns the tool result fields. On error, returns success:false, error and code, with optional credit approval details; success-only fields are absent.

message.description: A human-readable summary of the task creation result.

status.description: The initial task status, typically pending.

anyOf.description: Whether the effect task was created successfully.

task_id.description: The asynchronous task ID for status and result lookups.

task_type.description: The task category returned by Freebeat.
